authorized_by: Project owner, September 29, 2026, after the recommendation to stop paying for the quarantined legacy corpus.
scope: Lifecycle expiration of every root-level key beginning with shard_ (legacy pre-tokenized tensor shards, about 20,001,605 bytes each).
versioning: never enabled: expiration is permanent and leaves no noncurrent versions
reasons: Tokenized for the earlier SmolLM2-era tokenizer, not Granite (vocabulary 49,152 against 100,352).
Audit found duplicate rows, identifiers pointing to different bytes and overwritten objects.
Provenance and licensing never reviewed; quarantined since 0.4.0 and unused by any current or planned execution.
consequence: The v0.2 node client, which downloads shard_*.pt through the CloudFront CDN, can no longer fetch training shards.
